summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of U.S. dollar-denominated senior unsecured notes due 2036. Proceeds will fund a tender offer for existing 2030 notes and general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured and rank equally with other unsecured indebtedness. No specific price, spread, or dollar amount is provided. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction and not a special situation; no fundamental corporate event or strategic change is announced.
